description: Consent in vendor mode (SID_VENDOR_ID=755): a TC string needs consent for that vendor, and vendor consent (the core segment) for Purpose 1 and at least one of Purposes 2-10. The publisher TC segment isn't used. TC strings: …F5gAAA…g has vendor 755 and purposes 1-2; …F5AAA…B vendor 754 and purposes 1-2; the one starting CAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAE has vendor 755 and purpose 2 only; CAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA.eAAAAAAAAA publisher consent for purposes 1-2 only.
